implementation: A distinct transient disarm request identifies an exact equipped native NPC weapon without inventing zero condition or a break disposition. World validates winning quest status and pairs each request with one default-placement drop context.

The transaction preserves intact condition or the same contact's final fractional wear, ExtraScale and enchantment charge; existing drop publication provides registry identity, native drop relations, world body, inventory debit and deferred equipment observers.

For an Alive disarmed participant, known active process actions0..5 withdraw to-1; blocking6 withdraws without a shield and remains6 with a shield. Bound slot3 timing is retained independently; unbound logical strikes are consumed without inventing a sequence. Unknown process action rejects before publication.

A following Recoil replaces original slot3; Stagger preserves the disarm-staged passive source. Pending canceled actions are deduplicated before publication. Counter phase1 accepts only a victim disarm and retains its nondamaging contract.

Default disarm placement uses original48B080 actor position plus Euler-rotated[0,50,30] and unchanged actor angles. Existing breakage keeps carried-node placement. The new default mode guards all actor position/rotation bits, including signed zero.
